headlines.title: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney calls new U.S. tariffs ‘a miscalculation’
headlines.description: A new wave of tariffs will hit Canada early Saturday morning, with steep 50% duties in effect at the stroke of midnight.

headlines.title: GOP lawmakers criticize Trump’s beef import plan amid blowback from ranchers
headlines.description: House and Senate Republicans criticized President Donald Trump’s decision to suspend tariffs on ground beef imports, with lawmakers from agricultural states decrying the impact Trump’s decision will have on farmers.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: U.S. debt balloons to record-breaking $40 trillion
headlines.description: Total U.S. debt has toppled $40 trillion for the first time, doubling in just the past 9 years. NBC News' Allie Canal breaks down the significance of the latest numbers.

headlines.title: To Tip or Skip? Consumers Say They’ve Had Enough
headlines.description: While Americans love to reward good service, many are having second thoughts about the barrage of tip requests on practically everything. Restaurant technology platform Popmenu says 40% of consumers are tipping less in 2026 than in 2025 because of tipping fatigue, tighter budgets and rising prices. NBC’s Christine Romans reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Neutrogena faces backlash after death of Hayden Panettiere
headlines.description: The skincare brand Neutrogena is facing backlash over its parting ways with actress Hayden Panettiere a decade ago. The company is facing renewed scrutiny after Panettiere's death at the age of 36, with her comments about her relationship with Neutrogena resurfacing and going viral on social media.

headlines.title: Is it Ok to Max Out Your Credit Card As Long as You Pay it?
headlines.description: There are many misconceptions about credit card payments, balances and credit scores, so NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to set the record straight. She delves into whether cancelling a credit card impacts your score, if carrying a balance helps you build credit, and more.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Former Abercrombie & Fitch CEO Michael Jeffries competent to face sex trafficking trial, judge rules
headlines.description: Michael Jeffries, the former CEO of Abercrombie & Fitch who was charged with running an international sex trafficking scheme over several years while he ran the company, is mentally competent for trial, a federal judge ruled.

headlines.title: Neutrogena addresses backlash over its past brand deal with Hayden Panettiere
headlines.description: Panettiere said this year that the company had severed ties with her over a “morals clause” after she spoke about her postpartum depression.

headlines.title: ‘Rearranging deckchairs on the Titanic’: Bonds erase the impact of Treasury’s intervention
headlines.description: Bond yields jumped Thursday, erasing the declines stemming from the Treasury Department’s unusual intervention in the debt market a day earlier.

headlines.title: At Walmart, billions in tariff refunds soften the blow from slower sales growth
headlines.description: Walmart says it has received nearly $3 billion in tariff refunds — and used some of that windfall to cut prices for consumers strained by inflation.
